title: Grassmannian quantum cohomology in the infinite limit and total positivity
summary: The theory of total positivity was shown by Lusztig to be intrinsically linked to the canonical basis with its positivity properties. When we restrict ourselves to studying total positivity just for the set of lower-triangular unipotent Toeplitz matrices, say in type $A$, then there is a similar link with the quantum cohomology rings of flag varieties and the Schubert bases and their positivity properties.
